title: You Don't Have to Be Understood by Everyone
core_idea: Letting go of the need to be understood by everyone frees us to trust what we know without waiting for approval.
text: There is a particular tiredness that comes from explaining yourself again and again. Rewording the same story, hoping that this time it will land. Sometimes it does. And sometimes, no matter how carefully you speak, another person sees you through their own history and their own fears. Letting go can mean accepting that not everyone will understand you, and that this doesn't make you any less real. You can still be kind. You can still be honest. You simply stop waiting for their agreement before you trust what you know. There is a quiet freedom in that. Your life doesn't need to be approved to be yours.
description: A reflection on releasing the need to be understood by everyone, and the quiet freedom that can follow.
